Title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
Bid Submission Type: Dallas ISD prefers responses to be submitted online via the iSupplier portal. Manual submissions must be delivered to the Procurement Services Department in a sealed envelope; no fax or email submissions will be accepted.
Term of Bid: The term of this proposal shall be for a three (3) year agreement with two (2) successive one (1) year extensions based on the long-range needs of the District and mutual consent of both parties.
Pre Bid Meeting: A pre-proposal meeting will be held at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference on June 10, 2024.
Installation: All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Any Additional Documentation Required: M/WBE Compliance Guidelines & Forms; M/WBE Certificates; Affirmative Action, Equal Employment Opportunity or Supplier Diversity Plan; signed, dated and notarized Joint Venture Agreement; signed, dated and notarized Mentor Protege Agreement and Minutes or Prime-Subcontractor Teaming Agreement.
Product: laptops; desktops; tablet devices; display monitors
Bid Summary: This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District.
Product Specification: The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required by Dallas ISD. Requirements include 1920-1080 non-touch screen resolution, minimum 16GB RAM DDR5 memory, 802.11AX WiFi, a 4 GB video card where specified, and a 3-year minimum warranty for the applicable laptop tier. All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services.
